title: Operator JWTs are not signature or expiry verified; bare Bearer header passes operator checks
description:
## Problem

Operator auth on the deployed HTTP API (`auritus-api`) accepts forged and bare tokens.

1. `cdk/lambdas/authorizer/handler.py` only checks JWT shape, `alg`, `iss` and `aud`/`client_id`. It never verifies the RS256 signature against the Cognito user pool JWKS, and never checks `exp` or `token_use`. Anyone can mint an unsigned-by-Cognito token with the right claims and pass `/jobs/claimable`, `/admin/*` and `/sites`.
2. `_require_operator` in `cdk/lambdas/router/handler.py` only checks for a `Bearer ` prefix.
3. `PUT /jobs/{hash}/claim`, `/done`, `/failed` and `POST /jobs/{hash}/presign-upload` have **no** API Gateway authorizer. When the job token does not match they fall back to `_require_operator`, so `Authorization: Bearer x` lets anyone claim any job, mark it done or failed, or obtain an S3 upload URL that overwrites the job's audio. The job-token comparison is also not constant-time.

## Fix

- Shared Lambda layer (PyJWT + cryptography + `auritus_operator_auth.py`) used by the authorizer and the router.
- Verify RS256 signature against `https://cognito-idp.<region>.amazonaws.com/<pool>/.well-known/jwks.json`, exact issuer, `exp`, `token_use == access`, `client_id` in the allowed CLI/console clients. Fail closed on missing config.
- Router `_require_operator` performs the same verification (defense in depth; covers routes without the authorizer).
- `hmac.compare_digest` for job tokens.

## Acceptance

`features/operator_auth.feature`: forged, expired, wrong-`token_use`, wrong-client and bare `Bearer x` requests are rejected by the authorizer and by the router's job-mutation and admin routes; valid operator access tokens and valid job tokens are accepted.

comments.text: Merged to develop in #67 (3ef7eab), CI green. **Not deployed**: the live auritus-api still accepts forged tokens and bare `Bearer x` on job-mutation routes until `cdk deploy` runs. Keep open until deployed and probed (`PUT /jobs/x/claim` with `Bearer x` must return 403).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Deployed 2026-09-26 with `auritus deploy` (develop 864815c; changes: OperatorAuthLayer, RouterFn, AuthorizerFn, fallback role + state machine). Live probes: `PUT /jobs/x/claim` and `POST /jobs/x/presign-upload` with `Bearer x` -> 403; forged-signature token on `/admin/overview` and `/claim` -> 403; site-key `GET /jobs/{hash}` -> 404 job_not_found (router loads the layer); no errors in RouterFn/AuthorizerFn logs. Positive path with a real operator token not probed (local session expired).
